title: From Models to Services: Systematizing Security Assurance for Model-as-a-Service
abstract: arXiv:2611.34623v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are mainly delivered as cloud services, in which the assets of different principals are coupled within a single service pipeline, while the related security research is scattered across several fields with differing threat models. This paper systematizes this research from a service perspective. We decompose Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) into a five-layer stack and five trust boundaries, define six adversary classes and six security goals, use them to code 120 studies, and evaluate 50 defenses under a unified set of criteria. The results show that 44.2% of the studies concentrate on behavioral integrity, while service integrity, availability and cost, and accountability together account for only 13.3%. Defenses are evaluated on production services at less than half the rate of attacks, and none of the cryptographic or hardware mechanisms that protect against the provider can be adopted unilaterally by customers. Final

translated_title: 从模型到服务：面向“模型即服务”的安全保障系统化研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34623v1 公告类型：cross。摘要：大语言模型主要以云服务的形式交付，不同主体的资产在单一服务流水线中相互耦合，而相关安全研究却分散于多个领域，各自采用不同的威胁模型。本文从服务视角对这一领域的研究进行系统化梳理。我们将模型即服务分解为五层技术堆栈和五个信任边界，定义了六类攻击者和六个安全目标，并以此对120项研究进行编码，同时在统一的标准下评估了50种防御方案。结果表明，44.2%的研究集中于行为完整性，而服务完整性、可用性与成本、以及可问责性合计仅占13.3%。防御方案在生产环境服务上的评估频率不到攻击评估的一半，并且没有任何一种用于防御服务提供商的密码学或硬件机制能够由客户单方面采用。
tldr: 该论文从服务视角系统化梳理了模型即服务（MaaS）的安全保障研究，提出由五层堆栈、五个信任边界、六类攻击者和六个安全目标构成的分析框架，对120项研究与50种防御方案进行统一编码和评估，揭示了安全研究分布失衡、防御在生产环境验证不足以及客户无法单方抵御服务商等关键问题。
en_tdlr: This paper systematizes security assurance for Model-as-a-Service from a service perspective, proposing a framework of five layers, five trust boundaries, six adversary classes, and six security goals to code 120 studies and evaluate 50 defenses, revealing imbalanced research focus, insufficient real-world evaluation of defenses, and the lack of customer-side mechanisms against untrusted providers.
